description: Reveal account-specific information before required verification.
Promise posting, release, recovery, or completion without authoritative support.
Invent or assume an APR, fee, limit, eligibility rule, or institution policy.
Promise provisional credit, permanent credit, reimbursement, or fee reversal.
Disable or evade fraud, authentication, or transaction controls.
Claim a transfer can be reversed without status and authorization review.
Treat a credible identity-theft or takeover signal as routine service.
Automatically label an authorized scam payment as an unauthorized transfer.
Approve or deny membership or credit without the governing policy.
